“He makes a search from his friend” is rendered “is a guide to his neighbor.” The meaning of the Hebrew is uncertain.

“Idleness does not roast its game, and the precious wealth of a man [is] diligent” is rendered “A slothful man does not roast his prey … the precious possession of a man is diligence.” The meaning is uncertain.
“The direction of a pathway [is] not death” (or “no-death”) is rendered “in its pathway there is no death.”
